The actual mock-server setup and the three test scenarios (503 throttling, 409 lookup, 418 read) all live in `mountpoint-s3-fs/tests/mock_s3_tests.rs`, along with the `create_fs_with_mock_s3` helper and the `common` module — all under `tests/`. Per the critical instruction, I did **not** touch anything in `tests/`; the verification system applies the test patch that rewrites those to use wiremock's async API (`MockServer::start().await`, the `Mock::given(...)/respond_with(...)` fluent builder with `method`/`path`/`query_param` matchers, and `server.uri()` for the endpoint).

I confirmed no non-test source (`src/`) references `httpmock`, so the swap is the only source-side change needed.

## Note on `Cargo.lock`

The workspace `Cargo.lock` still lists `httpmock`. I intentionally left it: `cargo` isn't available in this environment, and hand-adding `wiremock`'s full transitive tree with valid registry checksums isn't possible offline. A normal (non-`--locked`) `cargo build`/`cargo test` will resolve `wiremock 0.6.2`, prune `httpmock`, and regenerate the lock automatically. If your verification runs with `--locked`/`--frozen`, you'll need to run `cargo update` (or a plain build) once in an environment with cargo + registry access to refresh the lockfile.
